title: Extreme poverty (proportion), 1820-2015
claim_summary: The proportion of the world population in extreme poverty fell sharply from the nineteenth century to 2015.
book_citation: Our World in Data, Roser & Ortiz-Ospina 2017, based on Bourguignon & Morrisson 2002 and World Bank 2016g.
notes: Book-period reconstruction is verified. The comparison layout was remediated so the recreated plot area is comparable to the Kindle crop; no comparable world extension is plotted.
